entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together with the parliament, we we..."
entries.dialogueText: Together with the parliament, we were going to declare the new constitution to the whole kingdom -- appointing a new government and a head of state. It was a big day.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was told that thousands of people..."
entries.dialogueText: I was told that thousands of people had already gathered in the plaza near the House, in anticipation of today's spectacle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was told that despite our not ann..."
entries.dialogueText: I was told that despite our not announcing the reforms publicly, hundreds of people had gathered in the plaza near the House, expecting our arrival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy turned onto a grand boul..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy turned onto a grand boulevard, lined with quince trees and cutting through Porte Drazon at its center, leading directly to the Old Town.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sidewalks were mostly empty, ex..."
entries.dialogueText: The sidewalks were mostly empty, except for the street vendors who were preparing to showcase their wares. It was an eerily quiet morning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sidewalks were slowly coming to..."
entries.dialogueText: The sidewalks were slowly coming to life, with street vendors preparing to showcase their wares, and large groups of people walking towards the parliament with Rizian flags in their hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, seated next to the driver, r..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, seated next to the driver, received a radio message. After listening to it, he turned his head towards me and pulled down the screen between us.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes. That's what we were told, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. That's what we were told, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. Due to a massive gat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Due to a massive gathering just outside the parliament, we're being redirected towards the second entrance of the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. We've just received..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. We've just received word from the security. The entrance to the House of Delegates is clear."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll be proceeding to enter the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll be proceeding to enter the complex from the Silver Gate within a couple minutes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for telling me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for telling me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope nothing's wrong.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope nothing's wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Finally.""
entries.dialogueText: "Finally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am very nervous, Titus.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am very nervous, Titus."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Everything will be fine. I know yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything will be fine. I know you've been planning for this day for a long time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The parliament building came into v..."
entries.dialogueText: The parliament building came into view, its plain facade adorned with flags and symbols of the nation's heritage, shining in the middle of the empty streets.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not at all, Your Majesty. Everythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all, Your Majesty. Everything is under control."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the convoy neared the House of D..."
entries.dialogueText: As the convoy neared the House of Delegates, the crowds and their chants thickened. Banners fluttered in the breeze, praising me for my selfless support for democracy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the convoy neared the House of D..."
entries.dialogueText: As the convoy neared the House of Delegates, the crowds and their chants thickened. Banners fluttered in the breeze, demanding change and reform in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the car pulled up to the entranc..."
entries.dialogueText: As the car pulled up to the entrance of the House of Delegates, I took a deep breath, steeling myself for the ceremony ahead.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Didn't you say there was a massive..."
entries.dialogueText: "Didn't you say there was a massive gathering?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is nobody around the House o..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is nobody around the House of Delegates. Why are we being directed to the Silver Gate again?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From the car window, I could just s..."
entries.dialogueText: From the car window, I could just see the Golden Gate, the main entrance of the parliamentary complex. However, there was no crowd waiting for us there.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept my thoughts to myself as we..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my thoughts to myself as we kept driving towards the building.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We were told to approach from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were told to approach from the southern side of the building for security reasons, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll be proceeding to enter the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll be proceeding to enter the complex from the Golden Gate within a couple minutes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Instead of going forward to the mai..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of going forward to the main entrance, the convoy took a turn before reaching the parliament.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The side street we were in was alre..."
entries.dialogueText: The side street we were in was already cleared of any bystanders. There was nobody on the street apart from a few policemen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we reached the end of the street..."
entries.dialogueText: As we reached the end of the street, the convoy stopped. I noticed Titus and the driver were receiving messages from their earpieces.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. We are on hold until..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. We are on hold until the police clear the way to the Silver Gate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for telling me, Titus. Is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for telling me, Titus. Is there something to be worried about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's wrong?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Nothing, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The police said they have to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police said they have to make sure there is no security risk for our convoy before letting us through."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few minutes passed, Titus m..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few minutes passed, Titus made a signal and called out to the police officer, who was standing in front of the convoy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She came to us with quick steps. Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: She came to us with quick steps. Titus lowered the window on his side of the car to speak with her.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What's taking so long? The King ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's taking so long? The King needs to join a session at the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The officer leaned in: "Sir. The en..."
entries.dialogueText: The officer leaned in: "Sir. The entrance hasn't been cleared yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We are waiting for additional forc..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are waiting for additional forces to arrive before commencing the clearance."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Will it take long?""
entries.dialogueText: "Will it take long?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""No, sir. We just need a few more m..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, sir. We just need a few more minutes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked my pocket watch. We were..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked my pocket watch. We were already late for the signing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Tell the police to let us t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Tell the police to let us through. I don't care about the security risks. This is the King's order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waited patiently."
entries.dialogueText: I waited patiently.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Tell the convoy that we're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Tell the convoy that we're going back to the palace."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm pretty sure you heard that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm pretty sure you heard that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded and turned back to the of..."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded and turned back to the officer.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. I don't know how we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. I don't know how we can turn the entire convoy around in this small street."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured at the Golden Guard's c..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured at the Golden Guard's cars behind us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The officer shook her head regretfu..."
entries.dialogueText: The officer shook her head regretfully.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, I noticed a group of armo..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, I noticed a group of armored vehicles passing by the street we weren't allowed on, driving in the direction of the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The officer continued to assure us..."
entries.dialogueText: The officer continued to assure us that it would take a few minutes at most before they could allow us to proceed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After noticing the armored cars ahe..."
entries.dialogueText: After noticing the armored cars ahead, Titus talked to his radio and asked for a situation report.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. There is something w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. There is something wrong."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The capital security has been put..."
entries.dialogueText: "The capital security has been put on emergency mode by Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The capital security has been put..."
entries.dialogueText: "The capital security has been put on emergency mode by General Azaro."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Chief Ricardus Toras has put all o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chief Ricardus Toras has put all of capital security on emergency mode."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently, a hundred trucks' wort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, a hundred trucks' worth of military equipment from Cardesse-Montaklar is being transferred to the capital right now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The police have been put on high a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police have been put on high alert."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Chief Ricardus Toras has put all o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chief Ricardus Toras has put all of capital security on emergency mode."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The capital police has been put on..."
entries.dialogueText: "The capital police has been put on high alert."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently, a hundred trucks' wort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, a hundred trucks' worth of military equipment from Iza is being transferred to the capital right now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently, a hundred trucks' wort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, a hundred trucks' worth of military equipment from Monqiz are being transferred to the capital right now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently, hundreds of Su Omina m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, hundreds of Su Omina members have arrived. They are suspected to be carrying weapons."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently, a hundred trucks' wort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, a hundred trucks' worth of military equipment from Brenas is being transferred to the capital right now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They must have been organizing sin..."
entries.dialogueText: "They must have been organizing since you announced the date of the constitutional reforms. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this before."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your rivals and key security perso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your rivals and key security personnel were already being watched. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this beforehand."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Somebody on the inside must have s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Somebody on the inside must have shared the details of what's happening today. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this beforehand."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This cannot be a coincidence. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "This cannot be a coincidence. But the police are trying to assure us everything is under control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should have known Rico would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have known Rico would be behind something like this. I'll make him pay."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. I don't think we can trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. I don't think we can trust any intelligence right now. Please take us to safety."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just tell the convoy to keep drivi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just tell the convoy to keep driving. I don't want to be pinned down on this small street."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want you to be on high alert, Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you to be on high alert, Titus. I don't trust the police."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what are those armored vehicle..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what are those armored vehicles doing inside the city?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They must be part of the police fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "They must be part of the police forces, sir. No military is allowed here."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What are your orders, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are your orders, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will listen to the officer and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will listen to the officer and wait here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded and immediately sent a..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded and immediately sent a radio message to the whole convoy.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as our drivers ignited the..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as our drivers ignited the engines, the leading officers from the blockade came running, surrounding our cars.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They shouted at me that they couldn..."
entries.dialogueText: They shouted at me that they couldn't let me leave. There was a security risk.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Move away from the vehicles or we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Move away from the vehicles or we will run you over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The officers hesitated, retreating..."
entries.dialogueText: The officers hesitated, retreating slightly. Murmurs crackled through their radios as they conferred swiftly amongst themselves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, they pointed their guns d..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, they pointed their guns directly at us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""STOP! THEY'RE GOING TO SHOOT!""
entries.dialogueText: "STOP! THEY'RE GOING TO SHOOT!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""FLOOR IT! NOW!""
entries.dialogueText: "FLOOR IT! NOW!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As our convoy inched forward, the o..."
entries.dialogueText: As our convoy inched forward, the officers paced alongside with their shouts of "halt", still maintaining a tight perimeter around us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""TITUS! OPEN FIRE!""
entries.dialogueText: "TITUS! OPEN FIRE!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing my screams, the guards read..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing my screams, the guards readied their weapons and started shooting. From my vantage point inside the vehicle, I could see the officers diving for cover.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And then, hell broke loose with gun..."
entries.dialogueText: And then, hell broke loose with gunshots erupting from each side.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For a split second, the driver's ey..."
entries.dialogueText: For a split second, the driver's eyes met mine in the rearview mirror as he nodded and slammed his foot on the gas pedal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we lurched forward, the officers..."
entries.dialogueText: As we lurched forward, the officers scrambled, trying to evade our vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Within a few seconds, the officers'..."
entries.dialogueText: Within a few seconds, the officers' widening eyes and their screams were swallowed by the roar of the engine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a minute or two, the same arm..."
entries.dialogueText: After a minute or two, the same armored vehicles we saw before began heading towards us from the direction of the parliament.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I tried to understand what was g..."
entries.dialogueText: As I tried to understand what was going on, a military officer leapt atop one of the vehicles, grabbed a megaphone and made an announcement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Lucita Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Lucita Azaro, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Taddeus Aza..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Taddeus Azaro, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Hugo Toras,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Hugo Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Ricardus To..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Ricardus Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Romus Toras. You are surrounded.""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus Toras. You are surrounded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""You are under arrest for conspirin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are under arrest for conspiring against the Rizian monarchy and the very title you hold."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""For attempting to dismantle the Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "For attempting to dismantle the Rizian monarchy, traitor Manus Sazon and the members of the Rizian People's Party have been arrested."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As his words echoed, I felt fear cr..."
entries.dialogueText: As his words echoed, I felt fear creep up in me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What are your orders?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are your orders?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""OPEN FIRE! NOW!""
entries.dialogueText: "OPEN FIRE! NOW!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need to do as they say.""
entries.dialogueText: "I need to do as they say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is nothing we can do, Titus...."
entries.dialogueText: "There is nothing we can do, Titus. I have to comply."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But sir!""
entries.dialogueText: "But sir!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing my screams, the driver slam..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing my screams, the driver slammed his foot on the brake pedal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Within a few seconds, the officers..."
entries.dialogueText: Within a few seconds, the officers quickly surrounded our vehicle and took us outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They pinned us down and with a clin..."
entries.dialogueText: They pinned us down and with a clink of metal handcuffs, they secured our wrists.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What the hell are you doing? I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell are you doing? I am your King!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must have mistaken me for some..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must have mistaken me for someone else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take your hands off me!""
entries.dialogueText: "Take your hands off me!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are not resisting. This is not..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not resisting. This is not necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not resisting. This is not ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not resisting. This is not necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not a common criminal. Take t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not a common criminal. Take these off of me!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever you do, please don't hurt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you do, please don't hurt my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One day, you will pay for this.""
entries.dialogueText: "One day, you will pay for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They did not react to what I said...."
entries.dialogueText: They did not react to what I said. They simply smiled as they disarmed my guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left the vehicle."
entries.dialogueText: I left the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They quickly pinned me down and, wi..."
entries.dialogueText: They quickly pinned me down and, with the clink of metal handcuffs, secured my wrists.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They did not react. They quickly di..."
entries.dialogueText: They did not react. They quickly disarmed the rest of my guards. The officer spoke to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""For attempting to dismantle the Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "For attempting to dismantle the Rizian monarchy, Manus Sazon and the traitors of the Rizian People's Party have been arrested."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""And you, Romus Toras, are under ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you, Romus Toras, are under arrest for conspiring against the Rizian monarchy and the very title you hold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am under WHAT?""
entries.dialogueText: "I am under WHAT?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Gentlemen! This is Rizian justice..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen! This is Rizian justice manifest!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One day, you will pay for this.""
entries.dialogueText: "One day, you will pay for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They grabbed me by my arms and shov..."
entries.dialogueText: They grabbed me by my arms and shoved me into a police truck.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had no idea where they were takin..."
entries.dialogueText: I had no idea where they were taking me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Within just a second, hell broke lo..."
entries.dialogueText: Within just a second, hell broke loose around me with gunshots erupting from each side. I threw myself on the floor of the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing my screams, the guards read..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing my screams, the guards readied their weapons and started shooting. From my vantage point inside the vehicle, I could see the officers diving for cover.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before any of us could react, there..."
entries.dialogueText: Before any of us could react, there was a deafening explosion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The engine of our vehicle roared as..."
entries.dialogueText: The engine of our vehicle roared as the driver hit the gas pedal. We quickly drove among the sounds of Kalsingtons being fired from every direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The world outside became a blur of..."
entries.dialogueText: The world outside became a blur of motion and noise. Bullets pinged against the armored exterior of the vehicle as we drove down the street.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We can't go back to the palace now..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't go back to the palace now. Take us to the emergency bunker!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The streets became a labyrinthine e..."
entries.dialogueText: The streets became a labyrinthine escape route, as we navigated through them with great speed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the aftermath of our escape, as..."
entries.dialogueText: In the aftermath of our escape, as we put distance between ourselves and the rebels, I let out a deep sigh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had survived this attack. But my..."
entries.dialogueText: I had survived this attack. But my usurper was still out there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was early in the morning. We wer..."
entries.dialogueText: It was early in the morning. We were driving in a sleek, black car adorned with the royal crest, towards the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus was seated up front next to t..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus was seated up front next to the driver. His eyes, reflected in the rearview mirror, had a steely coldness to them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry I didn't let you in on m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry I didn't let you in on my plans. But it was for your own safety."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better not sabotage these..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better not sabotage these reforms, Captain Gordion. You've seen what happens to people who get in my way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't talk to him."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't talk to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should know I'm dissolving the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should know I'm dissolving the Royal Council. But I hope I can still trust you with my personal security."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face assumed a concentrated loo..."
entries.dialogueText: His face assumed a concentrated look as received a radio message. After listening to it, he turned his head towards me and pulled down the screen between us.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Always, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Always, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I swore an oath to protect the Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swore an oath to protect the Rizian Crown, and I will do so for as long as it exists. No matter the changes to its role."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I stand ready to support your aims..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand ready to support your aims, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You did what you felt was necessar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did what you felt was necessary, sir. I hold no grudges."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Curiously, two of them bore the log..."
entries.dialogueText: Curiously, two of them bore the logo of Palantor Security Solutions.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Russello Montoro is undoubtedly mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Russello Montoro is undoubtedly mixed up in this somehow. I never liked him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few minutes passed, I start..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few minutes passed, I started getting restless.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I think we should listen to the po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we should listen to the police, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Just give it a couple more minutes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just give it a couple more minutes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I said take me out of here! NOW!""
entries.dialogueText: "I said take me out of here! NOW!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, Titus. I just gave you an orde..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Titus. I just gave you an order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. Let's wait.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. Let's wait."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But, si-""
entries.dialogueText: "But, si-"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, the same armored ve..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, the same armored vehicles we saw before began heading towards us from the direction of the parliament.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm afraid there's nothing more yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid there's nothing more you can do, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do we do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do we do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""OPEN FIRE! NOW!""
entries.dialogueText: "OPEN FIRE! NOW!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Please step out of the vehicle and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please step out of the vehicle and surrender to the authorities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What!?""
entries.dialogueText: "What!?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't tell me you are part of this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't tell me you are part of this, Titus..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought you had sworn an oath to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you had sworn an oath to protect the Crown at all costs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""TITUS! DRIVE!""
entries.dialogueText: "TITUS! DRIVE!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm afraid there is no way out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid there is no way out of this, sir. We are completely surrounded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me -- his eyes cold an..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The expected gunshots didn't arrive..."
entries.dialogueText: The expected gunshots didn't arrive. Titus turned to looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus didn't move. He turned to loo..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus didn't move. He turned to looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. I just gave you an order.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. I just gave you an order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then what the hell do we do!?""
entries.dialogueText: "Then what the hell do we do!?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""JUST DO IT!""
entries.dialogueText: "JUST DO IT!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm afraid there's nothing more we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid there's nothing more we can do, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm afraid there's nothing more I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid there's nothing more I can do, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm sorry, Your Majesty... but thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty... but this has been decided beyond me."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And I have. From within and from w..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I have. From within and from without."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Crown is more than the man who..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown is more than the man who wears it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Please, sir. There is no need to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, sir. There is no need to delay the inevitable."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Let's not make it any harder than..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not make it any harder than it already is. Please just step outside, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I don't? Are you going to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I don't? Are you going to drag me out like some petty criminal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it's you too, huh?""
entries.dialogueText: "So it's you too, huh?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What the hell, Titus? I entrusted..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell, Titus? I entrusted you with my life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I left the vehicle without saying a..."
entries.dialogueText: I left the vehicle without saying anything else.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I never wanted this, but my duty i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never wanted this, but my duty isn't to one man -- it's to the monarchy."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll do what I must. But I hope it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do what I must. But I hope it won't come to that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I left the vehicle without saying a..."
entries.dialogueText: I left the vehicle without saying anything else.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So this is how it ends.""
entries.dialogueText: "So this is how it ends."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're doing what you think is rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're doing what you think is right. I hope you can live with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You better pray they don't remembe..."
entries.dialogueText: "You better pray they don't remember this betrayal, Titus."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They will remember, sir. But as yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will remember, sir. But as you being the one who betrayed the monarchy and turned against the very Crown you wore."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We all carry something, sir. Some..."
entries.dialogueText: "We all carry something, sir. Some of us longer than others."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It didn't have to.""
entries.dialogueText: "It didn't have to."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But the moment you turned against..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the moment you turned against the throne, the path was set."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left the vehicle."
entries.dialogueText: I left the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You bastard! You drove me straight..."
entries.dialogueText: "You bastard! You drove me straight into enemy hands!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. The officer confirme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. The officer confirmed that the police is about to clear the way to the Silver Gate."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll just need a moment before we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll just need a moment before we're on our way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, I noticed a group of armo..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, I noticed a group of armored cars passing by the street we weren't allowed on, driving in the direction of the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The officer continued to assure us..."
entries.dialogueText: The officer continued to assure us that it would take a few minutes at most before they could allow us to proceed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico could be behind something. Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico could be behind something. Let's be careful about the police."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. I don't think we can trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. I don't think we can trust any intelligence right now. Please take us to safety."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just tell the convoy to keep drivi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just tell the convoy to keep driving. I don't want to be pinned down on this small street."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want you to be on high alert, Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you to be on high alert, Titus. I don't trust the police."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, what are those armored vehi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, what are those armored vehicles doing inside the city?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They must be part of the police fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "They must be part of the police forces, sir. No military is allowed here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will listen to the officer and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will listen to the officer and wait here."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What are your orders, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are your orders, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just as our drivers ignited the eng..."
entries.dialogueText: Just as our drivers ignited the engines, the leading officers removed the blockade and told us the road was now safe and clear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded and immediately sent a..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded and immediately sent a radio message to the whole convoy.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Well?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind. Maybe I was too parano..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. Maybe I was too paranoid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just take us to the House of Deleg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just take us to the House of Delegates, Titus. But be on high alert."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank God... Well, scratch that an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God... Well, scratch that and follow the road."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them to be faster.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell them to be faster."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, the leading officers rem..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, the leading officers removed the blockade and told us the road was now safe and clear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the avenue and drove thr..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the avenue and drove through the Silver Gate. Outside of the security cordon, thousands were waiting for us, holding Rizian flags and the banners of the reform movement.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "As the car pulled up to the entranc..."]
